description: This file contains functions for checking server version updates and related update status logic within the Mattermost admin console workspace optimization dashboard.

methods.name: testServerVersion
methods.description: Asynchronously tests the server version against the latest available version and returns status information.

methods.name: fetchAndCompareVersion
methods.description: Fetches the latest server version and compares it with the installed version, returning the type of update needed and status.

methods.name: runUpdateChecks
methods.description: Runs all update check functions and returns their results.
